etsy.title: DevOps Poster, FROM ubuntu:latest Container Joke, Works on My Machine Wall Art, Sysadmin Gift, Server Room Decor
etsy.description:
A funny DevOps poster for every container image that just ships 'my machine' to production, in dark-mode colors.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 8×10 in or 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang for a home office, dev den, or coding setup.

This listing is a physical poster print. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: DevOps posters on Etsy are mostly cheat sheets (container, cluster, CLI references) and job-definition prints.
A framed 'works on my machine' print and 'deploy first, debug later' shirts show the joke sells; framed DevOps prints were roughly $25-57.
Container humor elsewhere is stickers and shirts, not posters.
Amazon container/DevOps results are books and logo T-shirts; no humor posters surfaced.
Amazon programmer prints lead with the joke, then stack 'wall art', 'office decor', 'developer gift' and state 'unframed' plus size.

research.notes: Removed 'Docker' from the title and tags: the poster prints a Dockerfile line but not the Docker name. Ubuntu is printed on the poster, so it stays. Listing pages were not reachable from this environment; evidence is from search results only. No priceRange: snippets mixed digital downloads with framed prints, and no unframed physical prints with prices were comparable.
